## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow`, `pm:on-hold` until a `next` release carrying objectstack PR #23358 is what objectui resolves

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T03:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** the v18 upgrade makes boot-refused flows common. Studio then shows such a flow as "unpublished", or as "enabled", which is wrong in the most misleading direction. The platform half (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23316, p2) landed as PR #23358 at 2026-10-14T03:33Z.
- **Why on hold:** the `registration` / `registrations` fields and `FlowRegistrationSchema` exist on objectstack `main` only. objectui resolves `^18.0.0-next.0` (objectui#12337), and `18.0.0-next.0` predates them. A cross-repo unlock needs a fix the consumer can install.
- Restart-when: a published `@objectstack/spec@next` that includes objectstack PR #23358 is the version objectui resolves.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui` (Studio: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `FlowStatusDot`, `flow-problems.ts`). `Clause-②: no`: it reads a published field.
- **Direction: the card's ask, as written.**
  - A refused flow reads as refused and shows `reason.message` as sent. A registered flow reads as today. Absence falls back to today's behaviour.
  - ⛔ The stored `status` is not rewritten, and ⛔ `reason.message` is not parsed.
  - **Pins:** one per verdict, plus absence.

## Unlock scan: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` · objectui now resolves `18.0.0-next.1` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T20:06Z

- **objectui#12370 landed:** PR #12381 merged at 2026-10-14T19:35Z. objectui `main` now pins `@objectstack/spec` `^18.0.0-next.1`, and its lockfile resolves `18.0.0-next.1`.
- **The upstream fix is installable:** objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23358 (`d89f491ad0`, `FlowRegistrationSchema`) is an ancestor of the `18.0.0-next.1` tag commit `0c52e43075`. The restart condition in `6160490285` is met.
- **The grade is unchanged:** p2. Studio reads a status here; it does not write refused metadata. It is listed on objectui#12334.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`
Account: `baozhoutao` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12349`

Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the flow rail state, `FlowStatusDot`, the open-flow status), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-problems.ts` (`deriveFlowRunStatus`), `previews/FlowPreview.tsx`, the flow item / list read that carries `registration` / `registrations`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (or the Studio string table these surfaces already use), their tests, and a `.changeset/` entry (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: yes (widening; revised in place at 2026-10-15T00:49Z on the dev's measurement at PR #12403: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` gains `MetadataClient.listResponse` and the exported type `MetadataListAnswer`; was `no`). A contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue.
Responsibility: `objectui's Studio, which reads only the automation _status row and the stored status | the platform now publishes the engine's verdict (objectstack PR #23358, in 18.0.0-next.1) and objectui does not read it | every Studio author whose flow the engine refused at boot, common after the v18 upgrade`
Thread-read: 6177296388
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12326 (PR #12391, which also touched `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) landed as `28fb2a0`; this card was held behind it for that shared file. objectui#12329 (PR #12389, flow inspectors, simulator and `i18n.ts`) landed as `52a5d81`. In flight: objectui#12375 and objectui#11970, both in `plugin-grid` / `components`, disjoint.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12403 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T01:02Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `0a17f9e`, against the card's ask, triage's direction (`6160490285`) and the claim (`6180675332`, revised in place to `Clause-②: yes (widening)`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12349`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 701 lines, 11 files. `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` and `index.ts` are the flow list read the claim names.
- **Contract review: PASS**, comment `6181899470` on PR #12403, on this head `0a17f9e`. Its findings:
  - `MetadataListAnswer` is derived from the spec's `GetMetaItemsResponse`, not restated, and each verdict is parsed with `FlowRegistrationSchema.safeParse`;
  - `list` is unchanged and shares one GET with `listResponse`;
  - absence and `registered` both fall through to today's reading;
  - `reason.message` is shown verbatim, and the stored `status` is never written.
- **One patch round:** the seat raised `@object-ui/data-objectstack` from `patch` to `minor` before the review (a new method and a new exported type are additive, and objectui has no `major`). `@object-ui/app-shell` stays `patch`; its index exports are unchanged.
- **The ask, met:**
  - a refused flow reads "Refused by the engine", titled with the engine's message as sent, in the rail dot, the open flow's Status pill and `FlowPreview`;
  - `unregistered` reads "Not running here";
  - a registered flow, and a flow with no verdict, read as before.
  - Pins cover each verdict plus absence. Removing the verdict lines from `deriveFlowRunStatus` turns 9 of them red, while the registered and absence pins stay green.
- **Evidence:** the closure build and both type-checks exit 0. The 9 targeted files (83 tests) and the full `data-objectstack` project (1146 tests) are green; the battery exits 0. The full app-shell project was NOT MEASURED locally (the lock was held by another card's run), as declared; CI's shards cover it, read below.
- **Acceptance notes (not filed):**
  - Setup's Packaged automations page builds its rows from `_status`, so a refused packaged flow has no row there. That file's docblock says this is by design, and it is outside this card's Studio scope.
  - The Problems panel adds a run note only for not-running. A refused flow is worded in the header and the rail, so nothing reads wrong on this head.
- **CI at head:** 30 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`), `Type Check`, `Spec Main Shape Gate` and all 12 test shards included.
- **Label:** `needs:contract-review` is removed from the PR in this stroke.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

The 11th, `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, differs from that head by exactly the 17 changed lines of PR #12396 (`d12bc5f`, #12335's `reset()` `?package=`, merged first by another seat), and by nothing else.
